reason: The 'no effect' conclusion comes from an unjustified restriction to the north region. The full sample gives about 0.75 (SE 0.23, p=0.001) with the same controls, and the central and south regions are also significantly positive, at 0.81 and 1.07. Only the north subsample is null, and its CI is wide enough to include the other estimates, so the data do not show absence of an effect. The report also declares only one specification.
